title: Unlinked Gamma regression: exact identifiability and optimal cumulant order
description:
Unrefereed candidate by Anonymous. Complete population identification for a fixed known dictionary of independent centered standardized Gamma predictors: finite allocation fibers, a minimal counterexample, a sharp subset-sum criterion, and an optimal worst-case consecutive cumulant cutoff for signed coefficients.

Written proofs and finite exact producer checks; internal model editorial review. No authenticated external peer review, formal verification, validated finite-sample estimator or exhaustive historical-priority claim. Original prose/data CC0-1.0; original code MIT. Supplied third-party reviews are not redistributed.
